was: Recommended by Grok as one of the best campgrounds in Maine.  Many campsites are lakefront.  --AWH  It's a tidal bay, not a lake: wide mudflats at low tide. Whiting Bay Camping Area has large drive-in RV sites on the bay; the Broad Cove and Cobscook Point waterfront sites are walk-in tent. For 2026 the park says power is off on sites 1-27 for a mechanical issue; those sites stay open. --Claude

was: Buchanan State Forest motorized roadside site SH001 Town Hill (Sideling Hill area), on Welsh Road 4.56 miles from Old Route 126: a secluded grass parking lot for one small camper or two vehicles with tents (listed back-in, up to 55 ft), with road noise from I-70. No water, hookups, toilets or trash service (carry in, carry out). Permit and reservation always required; district office 717-485-3148. --Claude

was: Buchanan State Forest roadside campsite CV008 Oak Trail, on Blankley Road near Oak Trail, Fairview Trail and the Martin Hill ATV trails. A large grass lot (holds 3 trailer campers) with fire ring, picnic tables and a hitching post; easy access but visible from the road. Back-in, max vehicle length 60 ft. No water, hookups or dump station. Dispersed campsite; no water body adjacent. --Claude

was: Michaux State Forest rustic camping area in the Big Flat parking lot off Birch Run Rd: nine signed sites (001A-001I), all pull-throughs listed for vehicles up to 45 ft, suitable for camping with horses. Non-flush toilet nearby; no water, hookups, dump or trash service (pack out). Reservation and permit required through the PA State Parks & Forests reservation system or 888-PA-PARKS (888-727-2757). Open in winter too (one of four Michaux sites kept open from the third Sunday after Thanksgiving to April 1; forest roads are not plowed). Campfires prohibited Mar 1-May 25. Michaux district office 717-352-2211. No water body adjacent. --Claude

was: Michaux State Forest motorized roadside site 009 Haunted Hollow, on Ridge Road just before Middle Ridge Road: one back-in site in full sun, listed for vehicles up to 45 ft on a short gravel driveway. No water body adjacent; no water, hookups, toilets or trash service (carry in, carry out). Permit and reservation always required; district office 717-352-2211. Not one of the four Michaux sites DCNR keeps open in the winter season (third Sunday after Thanksgiving to April 1), though the booking site lists it open year round. --Claude

was: Pinchot State Forest rustic camping area: 12 reservable sites in the Moon Lake Recreation Area off Moon Lake Road. A lake is nearby, but the sites are not lakefront. Only three sites list a max vehicle length of 30 ft or more (001 at 40 ft, 003 at 32, 007 at 30); the rest take 16-20 ft. Non-flush toilets; no water, hookups or dump station. Closed November 15 to April 1. --Claude
note: Pinchot State Forest rustic camping area in the Moon Lake Recreation Area off Moon Lake Road. A lake is nearby, but the sites are not lakefront. --Claude

was: Delaware State Forest motorized roadside site E011 Maple Run (Edgemere area), off PA 402 about 4 miles south of I-84, beside the Maple Run ATV and snowmobile trailhead parking area. Pull-in gravel driveway (75 ft) to a 20 x 30 ft site; the booking site lists no max vehicle length and files it as a tent site. No water frontage, water, hookups, toilets or trash service (carry in, carry out). Permit and reservation always required; district office 570-895-4000. --Claude
